design.mood: Sophisticated, organic tech: a blend of high-end editorial typography and futuristic glass textures set against a haunting natural backdrop.
design.motion: Reveal-heavy motion with soft parallax on the botanical background. Headlines should use a 'blur-in' and upward slide effect, while glass containers use a subtle shimmering hover state to emphasize transparency.
guardrails: Avoid harsh primary colors; stick to the muted botanical-inspired palette.
Don't use solid backgrounds for containers; maintain a glassmorphic opacity of 20-30%.
Do not use standard sans-serif italics for emphasis; only apply the high-contrast serif italic for specific keywords.
Avoid sharp corners; all UI elements should have a radius between 8px and 24px.
design.centerpiece: A glassmorphic SaaS dashboard floating in front of a dark, moody botanical macro photograph with deep bokeh.

typography.display: Plus Jakarta Sans bold for main stems with Editorial New italic for emphasized keywords.
typography.mono: SF Mono or JetBrains Mono for system labels and data timestamps.
typography.body: Inter, sans-serif medium weight for readability.

design.layout: A centered vertical hierarchy featuring a floating navigation bar, a high-impact typographic hero section, and a recessed glass container for the product preview. All elements are anchored against a full-width atmospheric background layer.
